entries.champion.9041.name: Rift Herald
entries.champion.9041.title: The Void's Vanguard
entries.champion.9041.desc: Given by Phaisa (6) after 2 combats. A 4-cost Phaisa / Bruiser that every 8 s charges down the line in front of it for 250 magic damage and a 1.25 s knock-up.
entries.champion.9041.passive.name: Grows with the Rift
entries.champion.9041.passive.desc: Gains 15% max Health per player level.
entries.champion.9043.name: Phaisa Queen
entries.champion.9043.title: Mother of the Void
entries.champion.9043.desc: Offered in the shop (7 gold) to a player with 7 different Phaisa units on the board at level 10. Takes 2 board slots. Her attacks splash 30% physical damage to the enemies next to her target.
entries.champion.9043.passive.name: Sovereign
entries.champion.9043.ability.name: Void Torrent
entries.champion.9043.ability.desc: Every 3rd attack spits acid at the 3 largest groups of enemies: 480/720/1500 magic damage within 1 hex, 40% Armor shred for 4 s and a 1 s knock-up.
entries.champion.9042.name: Baron Nashor
entries.champion.9042.desc: Summoned by Phaisa (9) at the start of every combat. Every 3rd attack hits every enemy within 1 hex of its target for 300 magic damage.
entries.champion.9042.ability.name: Void Maw
entries.champion.9042.ability.desc: Every 3rd attack hits every enemy within 1 hex of its target for 300 magic damage.
entries.champion.9044.name: Invention
entries.champion.9044.desc: Hexagon's machine: untargetable, it stands on your right-most back hex and fires your modules 8 s into combat.
entries.champion.9044.passive.name: Workshop
entries.champion.9110.name: Stonebark Tree
entries.champion.9110.desc: A Nature plant. It does not attack until the forest comes to life (Nature 11).
entries.champion.9110.trigger.67.name: Falling Timber
entries.champion.9110.trigger.67.desc: On death, stuns the nearest 2/3/3 enemies for 1.5 s.
entries.champion.9111.name: Omnilium Blossom
entries.champion.9111.desc: A Nature plant. It never attacks.
entries.champion.9111.passive.name: Omnilium Bloom
entries.champion.9111.passive.desc: After 4 s of combat, Nature allies gain 10/15/30% Attack Damage and Ability Power. Every 4 s after that, they gain 3/5/10% more. It stops when the Blossom dies.
entries.champion.9112.name: Omnilium Protector
entries.champion.9112.trigger.69.name: Grove Warden
entries.champion.9112.trigger.69.desc: When a Nature ally dies, heals 54/97/175 Health and gains 80/100/250% Attack Speed for 3 s.
entries.champion.9112.ability.name: Bulwark Roar
entries.champion.9112.ability.desc: Gains a 300/450/800 (+100% AP) shield for 4 s and stuns the adjacent enemies for 1 s.
entries.trait.1.tagline: The Sun's Wrath. Rally: each time your team loses another 25% of its Health, Helios units' mana bars get 10% shorter.
entries.trait.1.bp3: Helios units gain 12 Armor and Magic Resist, and Rally.
entries.trait.1.bp5: Helios units gain 35 Armor and Magic Resist, and Rally.
entries.trait.1.bp7: Helios units gain 35 Armor and Magic Resist, and Rally. Each Rally smites every enemy for 15% of its max Health as true damage.
entries.trait.1.bp11: Helios units gain 150 Armor and Magic Resist, and Rally. Each Rally smites every enemy for 15% of its max Health and executes the enemies left below 25% Health.
entries.trait.2.tagline: The Void's Hunger. The strongest Phaisa units carry a mutation chosen by their class: Hyper-Adrenal (Assassin, Marksman, Duelist, Gunslinger: +15 Crit, 10% of damage as extra true damage), Chitinous Shell (Bastion, Protector: +250 Health, +30 Armor and Magic Resist), Caustic Spores (Sorcerer, Mystic: +20% AP, spells shred 15% Magic Resist) or Voidborn Siphon (everyone else: 12% Omnivamp). 7 different Phaisa units at level 10: the Phaisa Queen appears in your shop.
entries.trait.2.bp2: Phaisa units gain 8% Attack Speed. 1 mutation.
entries.trait.2.bp4: Phaisa units gain 18% Attack Speed. 2 mutations.
entries.trait.2.bp6: Phaisa units gain 33% Attack Speed. 3 mutations. After 2 combats, you receive the Rift Herald.
entries.trait.2.bp9: Phaisa units gain 40% Attack Speed. Every Phaisa unit is mutated and every mutation is supercharged (x2). Baron Nashor joins every combat.
entries.trait.3.tagline: The Perfect Equation. Build an Invention on your right-most back hex: 8 s into combat it fires every module you chose.
entries.trait.3.module.401.name: Electrical Overload
entries.trait.3.module.401.desc: Deals 100 true damage plus 8% of their max Health to every enemy.
entries.trait.3.module.402.name: Blast Shield
entries.trait.3.module.402.desc: Every ally gains a shield of 20% of its max Health for 6 s.
entries.trait.3.module.403.name: 90 Caliber Nets
entries.trait.3.module.403.desc: Stuns the 3 enemies who have dealt the most damage for 2 s.
entries.trait.3.module.404.name: E.M.P.
entries.trait.3.module.405.name: Continuum Cogs
entries.trait.3.module.405.desc: Allies gain 2 Mana per second and 20% Ability Power.
entries.trait.3.module.406.name: Overclocked Capacitors
entries.trait.3.module.407.name: Tuned Oscillator
entries.trait.3.module.407.desc: Healing and shields on allies are 25% stronger.
entries.trait.3.module.411.name: Magnetron Coil
entries.trait.3.module.411.desc: Hexagon units gain 5% Damage Amp for every ability they have cast so far.
entries.trait.3.module.412.name: Gigantification Ray
entries.trait.3.module.413.name: Micro-Rockets
entries.trait.3.module.413.desc: Fires 12 rockets at random enemies for 90 magic damage each.
entries.trait.3.module.414.name: Kinetic Barrier
entries.trait.3.module.414.desc: Hexagon units gain 40 Armor and Magic Resist.
entries.trait.3.module.415.name: Acceleration Gate
entries.trait.3.module.415.desc: Hexagon units gain 10 Mana per second for 4 s.
entries.trait.3.module.421.name: Mining Drill
entries.trait.3.module.422.name: Superior Lifeform
entries.trait.3.module.422.desc: Copies of your 2 strongest Hexagon units join the fight with 60% of their Health and Attack Damage.
entries.trait.3.module.423.name: Upgrade!
entries.trait.3.module.423.desc: Hexagon units gain 40% Attack Speed and 30% max Health.
entries.trait.3.module.424.name: Echo Engine
entries.trait.3.module.424.desc: The Invention fires your other modules again every 8 s.
entries.trait.3.module.425.name: Armor Nullifier
entries.trait.6.tagline: The Moon's Shadow. Every match, one of two paths is chosen at random.
entries.trait.6.path0.name: Path of Enlightenment
entries.trait.6.path0.bp3: Selini units gain 10% Attack Damage and Ability Power, +2% per player level. Gain 1 XP after every combat.
entries.trait.6.path0.bp5: Selini units gain 15% Attack Damage and Ability Power, +3% per player level. Gain 2 XP after every combat.
entries.trait.6.path0.bp7: Selini units gain 20% Attack Damage and Ability Power, +4% per player level. Gain 4 XP after every combat.
entries.trait.6.path1.name: Path of Prosperity
entries.trait.6.path1.bp3: Selini units gain 10% Attack Damage and Ability Power, +2% per gold this path has paid. Every 4 takedowns by Selini units pay 1 gold.
entries.trait.6.path1.bp5: Selini units gain 25% Attack Damage and Ability Power, +2% per gold this path has paid. Every 4 takedowns by Selini units pay 1 gold.
entries.trait.6.path1.bp7: Selini units gain 40% Attack Damage and Ability Power, +2% per gold this path has paid. Every 4 takedowns by Selini units pay 1 gold.
entries.trait.7.tagline: The Cosmic Link. Star dust: after a lost combat gain 20 + 5 x your loss streak, and 2 per Najmi takedown. Each time it comes in, a prototype is offered: take it, or bank the dust for a better one (35: a completed item, 70: a choice of 3, 100: cash out an item and 10 gold).
entries.trait.7.bp3: Collect star dust. When a Najmi unit casts, adjacent allies gain 15 Mana.
entries.trait.7.bp5: Collect star dust. When a Najmi unit casts, adjacent allies gain 25 Mana.
entries.trait.7.bp6: Prismatic: all star dust is doubled. When a Najmi unit casts, adjacent allies gain 25 Mana.
entries.trait.2.mutation.0.name: Hyper-Adrenal
entries.trait.2.mutation.1.name: Chitinous Shell
entries.trait.2.mutation.2.name: Caustic Spores
entries.trait.2.mutation.3.name: Voidborn Siphon
entries.trait.10.name: Bastion
entries.trait.10.tagline: Every ally gains 10 Armor and Magic Resist.
entries.trait.10.bp2: Bastions gain 20 Armor and Magic Resist.
entries.trait.10.bp4: Bastions gain 45 Armor and Magic Resist.
entries.trait.10.bp6: Bastions gain 80 Armor and Magic Resist.
entries.trait.11.name: Bruiser
entries.trait.12.name: Sorcerer
entries.trait.13.name: Marksman
entries.trait.13.bp2: Marksmen gain 12% Attack Speed and deal 10% more damage.
entries.trait.13.bp4: Marksmen gain 30% Attack Speed and deal 20% more damage.
entries.trait.14.name: Mystic
entries.trait.14.bp2: Every ally gains 20 Magic Resist and 1 Mana per second.
entries.trait.14.bp4: Every ally gains 50 Magic Resist and 2 Mana per second.
entries.trait.15.name: Duelist
entries.trait.15.tagline: Every basic attack makes a Duelist faster, up to 12 times.
entries.trait.15.bp2: Duelists gain 4% Attack Speed per attack.
entries.trait.15.bp4: Duelists gain 7% Attack Speed per attack.
entries.trait.15.bp6: Duelists gain 10% Attack Speed per attack.
entries.trait.16.name: Gunslinger
entries.trait.16.tagline: Every 4th attack from a Gunslinger deals bonus physical damage.
entries.trait.16.bp2: Gunslingers gain 22% Attack Damage; every 4th attack deals 100 bonus damage.
entries.trait.16.bp4: Gunslingers gain 45% Attack Damage; every 4th attack deals 220 bonus damage.
entries.trait.17.name: Nature
entries.trait.17.tagline: The First Forest. Gain plants for your board (they take no board slot). Plants gain 25% max Health and 10% Ability Power per Nature star level.
entries.trait.17.bp3: Gain a Stonebark Tree and an Omnilium Blossom.
entries.trait.17.bp5: Gain a second Stonebark Tree. Stonebark Trees gain 200 Health.
entries.trait.17.bp11: Plants are 3-star and the forest comes to life: the trees walk and fight.
entries.trait.18.name: Hexa
entries.trait.18.tagline: Hexa's own trait: the ally behind it becomes its pilot.
entries.trait.19.name: Plant
entries.trait.19.tagline: A Nature plant: no board slot, never on the bench, cannot be sold.
entries.item.48.name: Nature Emblem
entries.item.48.desc: Grants +1 Nature to the wearer. Recipe: Omnilium Seed + Omnilium Seed.
